surface_name: Supabase service role or secret key clients
title: Supabase client created with the service role key still gets RLS errors or empty results
symptoms: new row violates row-level security policy from a client built with the service_role or sb_secret key
Admin queries return [] in a Next.js server action using createServerClient
Service role client stops bypassing RLS after calling signUp or signInWithPassword on it
cause: RLS is decided by the Authorization header, not the apikey header. SSR clients copy the user session from cookies into that header, and auth calls on a shared client replace it with the user's JWT.
fix: Build a separate admin client with plain createClient, no cookies, and session persistence off. Create users with auth.admin.createUser rather than signUp on that client.
affected: supabase-js 2.x and @supabase/ssr; legacy service_role keys and new secret keys alike
